items.title: Session init banner
items.description: Prints project name, sprint/registry file freshness (>24h stale warning), active work item, and uncommitted-change count at session start. Requires CURRENT_SPRINT.md / COMPONENT_REGISTRY.md (or configured equivalents) to say anything beyond the banner.

items.title: Block duplicate component creation
items.description: Blocks (exit 2) creating a new file under components/|hooks/|utilities/|actions/ paths whose name closely matches an existing entry in COMPONENT_REGISTRY.md. Requires that registry file to exist; a no-op without it.

items.title: Warn about unstaged related files
items.description: On `git commit` commands, checks staged .ts/.tsx files for an unstaged related hook file, or staged schema/model changes without a staged types file, and surfaces findings to Claude via additionalContext. Advisory only — never blocks the commit.

items.title: Suggest a relevant skill from the prompt
items.description: Pattern-matches the submitted prompt against implementation/bugfix/refactor/completion/context-fatigue/performance keyword sets and surfaces a suggested skill to Claude via additionalContext. Advisory only — never blocks the prompt.
